Coffee & Contracts vs VEXI: Which Is Better for Realtors in 2026?
Coffee & Contracts and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Compare Coffee & Contracts vs VEXI side-by-side. See pricing, features, and why 1,000+ realtors chose VEXI.

Coffee & Contracts gives you ready-made real estate content every week, an AI social media strategist called Beans, and tools to turn followers into leads [1]. VEXI makes posts, videos, designs and captions from what you ask for. The two overlap on social media and work in different ways.

Coffee & Contracts calls itself the social media marketing operating system for real estate agents, and says 6,000+ agents use it [1]. Its team designs new content every week, and its library holds 1,000+ Canva templates, from posts and reels to printable guides and email templates [1]. Beans, its AI social media strategist, helps you plan your week, make each post yours and set up lead capture, and its lead magnets, landing pages and link in bio collect leads for you [1]. You post to your own account, and it says scheduling straight to Instagram is coming soon [1]. For one agent it costs $74 a month billed monthly, $199 every 3 months or $740 a year, with new pricing from $99 a month starting Nov 25 [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on social media and work in different ways. Here is what each one does.

VEXI does it all for you.

Real people on the Coffee & Contracts team design every post, carousel and reel template, based on what is working for agents on Instagram each week [1]. Beans then helps you make each one yours, in your brand and your voice [1].
VEXI creates original content for your brand.

Coffee & Contracts turns your guides and quizzes into landing pages, gives you a link in bio, and collects everyone who signs up in Leads, which you can export to your CRM [1]. It also has Instagram analytics and audit reports, weekly trainings and a community [1].
Coffee & Contracts says scheduling straight to Instagram is coming soon: Beans will line up your posts for the week, and you approve them before anything goes out [1].

Is Coffee & Contracts a done-for-you service?

Its team makes new content every week, and Beans helps you plan it and make it yours [1]. You post to your own account, and Coffee & Contracts says scheduling straight to Instagram is coming soon [1].
Does Coffee & Contracts help with reels?
Yes. Its team designs reel templates, many of them B-roll reels that don’t need your face, and Beans gives you a shot list and a script when you want to film [1].
Which platforms does Coffee & Contracts support?

Coffee & Contracts is built around Instagram: Beans works from your Instagram numbers, its analytics and audit reports cover your Instagram, and scheduling to Instagram is coming soon [1]. Its library also has printable guides and email templates [1].
Does Coffee & Contracts help with leads?
Yes. It turns a guide or a quiz into a landing page that collects names and emails, puts it on your link in bio, and adds everyone who signs up to Leads [1].
How much does Coffee & Contracts cost?

For one agent, Coffee & Contracts costs $74 a month billed monthly, $199 every 3 months or $740 a year [2]. Its page says new pricing starts Nov 25, with plans at $99, $139 and $199 a month, and teams of 50 or more can ask about Enterprise [2]. There is no contract, and you can cancel anytime [1][3].
